title: World Experience Atlas for the Sovereign Desktop Estate
objective: Import mature mechanisms from build systems, distributed systems, databases, HPC, compilers, verification, security, decision science, and human factors as explicit desktop gaps and falsifiable build candidates.
laws: A borrowed pattern is a hypothesis until it improves accepted work or operator attention on this estate.
The source discipline's mechanism must be preserved; brand-name imitation is insufficient.
Every pattern names the current gap, desktop translation, first experiment, dependencies, and failure default.
Reused outputs require exact identity or an independently proved equivalence relation.
Automation that shifts hidden work to the operator has not improved the system.
Security, provenance, and rollback are part of capability, not deployment ceremony.
A more complex subsystem must repay its build and maintenance burden.
The atlas is a queue and control surface, not evidence that any pattern is already implemented.

implemented: durable task queue and bounded repository execution
sovereign desktop context and cache planning

references.title: egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation
State of Mutation Testing at Google
Online Multi-LLM Selection via Contextual Bandits

patterns.title: Content-addressed action cache
patterns.mechanism: Hash the complete action contract and store result metadata separately from immutable output blobs.
patterns.current_gap: The estate caches model context and receipts, but it does not yet reuse every deterministic or model-assisted action by exact input identity across projects.
patterns.desktop_translation: Give extraction, retrieval, validation, rendering, tests, model calls, and compilation one action key over source hashes, tool versions, prompts, environment, and expected outputs.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: At least 30% of repeated bounded work will be satisfiable from an action cache without re-execution, with zero acceptance regression.
patterns.first_experiment: Replay 100 historical Tier Desk jobs after canonicalizing their action inputs; measure exact reusable hits and poisoned-hit detection.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Hermetic action envelopes
patterns.mechanism: Declare every input, tool, environment variable, network permission, and output so an action cannot depend on ambient machine state.
patterns.current_gap: Backend manifests bind models and prompts, but ordinary utilities and future local workers can still inherit undeclared PATH, files, clocks, or network state.
patterns.desktop_translation: Run each action in a disposable packet with a minimal environment, explicit tool digests, and denied-by-default undeclared reads.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Hermetic execution will reduce irreproducible accepted runs and make cross-machine cache reuse safe.
patterns.first_experiment: Select 30 previously accepted jobs, rerun under a stripped environment, and classify hidden ambient dependencies.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Dependency-directed invalidation
patterns.mechanism: Invalidate only outputs whose declared dependency closure changed.
patterns.current_gap: Context packs already distinguish stable and dynamic blocks, but derived artifacts across the estate are not maintained as a unified incremental dependency graph.
patterns.desktop_translation: Record artifact-to-source edges and compute the minimal dirty subgraph after each Git, chat, source, or model update.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Dependency-directed invalidation will cut rebuild work by at least 60% on append-heavy estates without serving stale outputs.
patterns.first_experiment: Apply 20 controlled source changes to AXM and Clifford fixtures and compare whole-estate rebuild versus minimal invalidation.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Ephemeral sovereign compute extension
patterns.mechanism: Move a hermetic action to temporary remote hardware while preserving the same input and output contract.
patterns.current_gap: Remote open-weight compute is conceptual but lacks a standard checkout, execute, seal, and repatriate contract.
patterns.desktop_translation: Package a source and weight-bound action, run it on rented compute, import only signed outputs and telemetry, then destroy the worker.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Checkpointed ephemeral compute will make oversized open-weight experiments practical without transferring control of the estate.
patterns.first_experiment: Run one open-weight quantization or LoRA action locally and on a temporary remote GPU using identical action digests.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Event-sourced durable workflows
patterns.mechanism: Persist state transitions and rebuild workflow state by deterministic replay instead of trusting one mutable row or resident process.
patterns.current_gap: Monster Wrangler persists task state, but it does not yet expose a general workflow history with code-version replay semantics for every long-running estate process.
patterns.desktop_translation: Represent each campaign as commands, events, timers, activity results, and versioned transitions; model calls and side effects remain external activities.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A crashed or upgraded workflow will resume without redoing accepted work or losing causal state.
patterns.first_experiment: Kill the scheduler at every transition of a 20-step campaign, restart on changed code, and verify identical terminal state or an explicit version gate.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Idempotent side-effect ledger
patterns.mechanism: Bind every external effect to an idempotency key and record intent, attempt, result, and reconciliation.
patterns.current_gap: Receipts cover model work, but email, calendar, Git writes, browser actions, downloads, and remote jobs can still duplicate after retries.
patterns.desktop_translation: Add an outbox and effect ledger so retries may repeat computation but cannot repeat a committed external effect.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Crash retries will produce exactly one accepted side effect or a visible unresolved reconciliation state.
patterns.first_experiment: Inject crashes before and after 50 fixture side effects and verify no duplicate commit, message, file write, or campaign start.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Supervisor tree for workers and services
patterns.mechanism: Assign restart scope and intensity by dependency: one-for-one, rest-for-one, or one-for-all.
patterns.current_gap: The Desk has a supervisor, but the growing local runtime, indexers, model servers, cache managers, and browser bridges lack an explicit fault-containment tree.
patterns.desktop_translation: Model each daemon as a supervised child with health contract, restart budget, dependency ordering, and escalation state.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Explicit supervision will reduce full-estate stops and prevent restart storms from hiding structural faults.
patterns.first_experiment: Run a fault matrix over model server, indexer, cache registry, Desk, and validator failures and measure containment and recovery.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Compensating transactions for multi-system work
patterns.mechanism: When a multi-step process cannot be atomically committed, record compensating actions for each completed step.
patterns.current_gap: Cross-repository and connector workflows can partly succeed, leaving valid but unwanted state that manual cleanup must reconstruct.
patterns.desktop_translation: Require every non-atomic workflow to declare compensation, irreversible boundaries, and operator approval points.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Compensation-aware workflows will recover from partial failure with fewer manual forensic steps.
patterns.first_experiment: Execute a fixture spanning Git branch, generated artifact, calendar event, and message draft, then fail each step and evaluate restoration.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Cost-based work optimizer
patterns.mechanism: Compile work to a logical plan, enumerate valid physical plans, and select using measured cost rather than a fixed ladder.
patterns.current_gap: The waterline and theory systems measure routes, but production routing still relies mainly on operator-declared order and local preference.
patterns.desktop_translation: Estimate acceptance probability, attention, cache locality, load cost, context cost, and resource wait for each valid plan.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A learned cost model will reduce cost per accepted result without increasing defects or operator attention.
patterns.first_experiment: Replay 200 historical jobs through fixed routing and an offline cost-based planner using only evidence available at dispatch time.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Adaptive plan correction
patterns.mechanism: Update estimates when observed retrieval volume, output length, failure rate, or tool selectivity differs from the plan.
patterns.current_gap: Current plans are frozen correctly for evidence, but production plans do not adapt within declared safe bounds when estimates are wrong.
patterns.desktop_translation: Permit bounded re-optimization at checkpoint boundaries while preserving the original logical contract and recording the plan change.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Adaptive correction will reduce pathological long runs caused by bad context or output estimates.
patterns.first_experiment: Seed wrong selectivity and output-length estimates into 50 jobs and compare frozen physical plans with checkpointed re-optimization.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Incremental materialized knowledge views
patterns.mechanism: Maintain derived indexes, summaries, graphs, and reports by applying source deltas rather than regenerating the whole result.
patterns.current_gap: AXM and Clifford preserve source lineage, but many useful projections are still rebuilt or resynthesized from scratch after new evidence.
patterns.desktop_translation: Treat relationship recaps, project state, source coverage, graph topology, and model waterlines as materialized views with explicit delta rules.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Incremental views will keep recurring situational awareness current at a fraction of full regeneration cost.
patterns.first_experiment: Append, edit, and retract records in a chat and evidence fixture; measure changed outputs and verify unaffected outputs remain byte-identical.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Bitemporal claims and retraction propagation
patterns.mechanism: Track both when a fact was valid in the world and when the estate learned or revised it, then propagate retractions through dependent views.
patterns.current_gap: The estate records provenance and fault lines, but downstream summaries can remain semantically stale after an upstream correction.
patterns.desktop_translation: Add valid-time, transaction-time, support edges, and retraction events to every durable claim and generated projection.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A corrected source will automatically mark every dependent conclusion stale, superseded, or still supported.
patterns.first_experiment: Retract one load-bearing source from a Clifford fixture and verify all affected paths and narratives are invalidated without touching independent claims.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Deadline-safe backfill scheduling
patterns.mechanism: Run lower-priority jobs in resource gaps only when their estimated completion cannot delay reserved higher-priority work.
patterns.current_gap: Resource lanes serialize contention, but idle gaps are not yet filled using runtime estimates and reservations.
patterns.desktop_translation: Add duration distributions, deadlines, preemption class, and reservation windows to Tier Desk.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Backfill will increase local GPU utilization without delaying operator-promised or dependency-critical work.
patterns.first_experiment: Replay a month of synthetic and historical queue arrivals under strict priority and conservative backfill.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Checkpointable and preemptible local work
patterns.mechanism: Persist bounded progress so long local jobs can yield to urgent work and resume without restarting.
patterns.current_gap: Campaign attempts are isolated, but most model and data-processing activities remain whole-run units.
patterns.desktop_translation: Define checkpoint contracts for retrieval, document batches, training epochs, code search, and multi-trial generation.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Checkpointing will make night-shift local work compatible with urgent foreground use and hardware maintenance.
patterns.first_experiment: Preempt jobs at random intervals across five task families and compare lost compute, corruption, and operator recovery.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Parametric job arrays
patterns.mechanism: Represent systematic sweeps as one indexed job family with shared inputs and per-cell parameters.
patterns.current_gap: Theory plans produce many runs, but their operational representation can still expand into individually managed jobs.
patterns.desktop_translation: Compile model, context, quantization, prefix, and retry sweeps into array manifests with one shared source packet.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Job arrays will reduce queue and review overhead for large experimental matrices.
patterns.first_experiment: Compile the 22-theory matrix into array groups and compare control-state size and operator actions.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Energy and thermal-aware scheduling
patterns.mechanism: Treat power, heat, fan noise, and thermal throttling as resources and costs.
patterns.current_gap: The estate tracks GPU lanes and time but not energy, heat-soak, or apartment-level operating constraints.
patterns.desktop_translation: Record power draw, temperature, throttling, and time-of-day policy per accepted task.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Some overnight schedules and quantizations will yield more accepted work per kWh and less thermal contention.
patterns.first_experiment: Run identical long jobs at several power limits and ambient windows; compare accepted yield, energy, and maintenance burden.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Typed intermediate representation for work
patterns.mechanism: Lower natural-language goals into a typed graph of sources, transformations, effects, tests, and authority boundaries.
patterns.current_gap: Campaign JSON describes execution, but there is no general semantic IR shared across research, code, documents, visuals, and personal operations.
patterns.desktop_translation: Introduce operators such as retrieve, parse, compare, synthesize, execute, verify, publish, and ask, each with typed inputs and outputs.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A typed work IR will expose reusable subwork, invalid effects, and deterministic lowering opportunities before a model is called.
patterns.first_experiment: Encode 25 historical requests in the IR and measure ambiguous fields, reusable operators, and model-free lowering.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Deterministic-first lowering
patterns.mechanism: Lower each IR operator to the least expressive adequate executor: parser, SQL, regex, solver, compiler, script, local model, then frontier.
patterns.current_gap: The router chooses among models well, but many tasks should exit the model economy entirely.
patterns.desktop_translation: Maintain an executor registry with semantic contracts and proofs of equivalence for deterministic implementations.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: At least half of recurring sub-operators will become deterministic or validator-selected local code.
patterns.first_experiment: Decompose 100 recent tasks into IR operators and count which can be executed by existing deterministic tools.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Common-subwork elimination and partial evaluation
patterns.mechanism: Compute invariant portions once and reuse them across jobs; precompute stages whose inputs are already known.
patterns.current_gap: Context prefixes are reused, but repeated searches, source normalization, grading setup, and report fragments are not universally deduplicated.
patterns.desktop_translation: Hash every IR node and replace duplicate nodes with references to one accepted result.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: IR-level common-subwork elimination will reduce repeated tool and model calls across campaigns.
patterns.first_experiment: Compile ten related repository and research tasks together and compare naive versus deduplicated execution graphs.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Alternative-plan search with equality saturation
patterns.mechanism: Represent equivalent work plans together, apply sound rewrites, and extract the cheapest plan under current costs.
patterns.current_gap: The system generally commits to one decomposition before execution and may miss structurally equivalent cheaper plans.
patterns.desktop_translation: Define verified rewrites such as retrieve-before-summarize, batch-independent-calls, reuse-materialized-view, and solver-before-model.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: For bounded work, equivalent-plan search will discover lower-cost plans that hand-authored sequencing misses.
patterns.first_experiment: Build a tiny IR grammar for evidence synthesis and code repair, enumerate verified rewrites, and compare extracted plans with human plans.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Mutation-derived verifier gaps
patterns.mechanism: Inject small plausible faults and test whether the existing acceptance system detects them.
patterns.current_gap: Hidden graders exist for selected tasks, but verifier strength is not continuously measured across the estate.
patterns.desktop_translation: Generate scoped mutants in code, schemas, policy rules, and evidence claims; retain only actionable survivors.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Mutation testing will reveal where green tests still permit the exact failure modes models exploit.
patterns.first_experiment: Run diff-based mutation over Tier Bench and one AXM pipeline change; classify live mutants and review burden.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Fuzzing and property-generated acceptance
patterns.mechanism: Generate adversarial inputs from interface contracts and invariant properties rather than hand-enumerated examples.
patterns.current_gap: Many tasks rely on fixed examples and can pass while failing unseen combinations or malformed inputs.
patterns.desktop_translation: Create reusable fuzz drivers for parsers, schemas, CLI surfaces, context packs, receipts, and model output adapters.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Continuous fuzzing will find robustness defects and manufacture fresh hidden-grade cases.
patterns.first_experiment: Auto-generate drivers for five high-value interfaces and run bounded fuzz campaigns with reproducible seeds.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Metamorphic and differential graders
patterns.mechanism: When exact answers are costly, test relations that must remain true under controlled transformations or compare independent implementations.
patterns.current_gap: Subjective and research tasks often lack cheap exact graders, leaving frontier narration too close to acceptance.
patterns.desktop_translation: Define transformations such as source reorder, irrelevant-source injection, paraphrase, unit conversion, and alternate solver execution.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Metamorphic relations will expand hidden evaluation into tasks that currently require manual judgment.
patterns.first_experiment: Author ten relations for evidence synthesis, retrieval, visual layouts, and repository planning; measure discriminative power.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Flake-aware evidence adjudication
patterns.mechanism: Model nondeterministic failures explicitly instead of retrying until a preferred result appears.
patterns.current_gap: K-receipt evidence separates error from failure, but task-level flakiness and noisy graders are not yet estimated and localized.
patterns.desktop_translation: Track per-test flake rates, environmental covariates, and Bayesian culprit likelihood; quarantine unstable acceptance.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Flake-aware adjudication will prevent false model walls and false clears while reducing wasteful reruns.
patterns.first_experiment: Introduce controlled flaky tests into 30 campaigns and compare naive K-of-N with a flake-aware classifier.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Taint tracking for model-derived data
patterns.mechanism: Mark untrusted model output and propagate that label through files, commands, summaries, and effects until independently validated.
patterns.current_gap: Receipts preserve provenance, but downstream tools can still treat generated text as trusted instructions or authoritative facts.
patterns.desktop_translation: Add trust labels and permitted transformations to every artifact and IR edge.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Taint enforcement will block prompt-injected instructions and unsupported generated claims from reaching privileged effects.
patterns.first_experiment: Seed malicious and merely incorrect model outputs into a multi-step fixture and verify where trust is upgraded or refused.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Capability and egress kernel
patterns.mechanism: Give each action only explicit object capabilities and network destinations instead of ambient filesystem, shell, and Internet authority.
patterns.current_gap: Tier Run constrains files and tools, but the wider estate will add browsers, connectors, remote compute, and service daemons.
patterns.desktop_translation: Issue short-lived capabilities for read, write, execute, network, credential use, and human-visible effects.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Capability confinement will contain compromised models and faulty workers without requiring perfect prompt behavior.
patterns.first_experiment: Run a red-team fixture that attempts path escape, credential discovery, arbitrary egress, and undeclared side effects.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: SLSA-style attestations for models and artifacts
patterns.mechanism: Attach verifiable provenance describing source, builder, parameters, dependencies, and outputs.
patterns.current_gap: Code and AXM artifacts are signed selectively, but models, quantizations, adapters, prompts, indexes, and cache files lack one uniform supply-chain statement.
patterns.desktop_translation: Generate attestations for every promoted model cartridge and capture artifact, with separate builder and verifier identities.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Attestations will make machine rebuild, tamper detection, and successor custody materially stronger.
patterns.first_experiment: Rebuild one local model cartridge and one distillation artifact from declared inputs and compare hashes and provenance.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Quarantine, canary, and shadow execution
patterns.mechanism: Observe new models, prompts, adapters, and policies on duplicated work before granting production authority.
patterns.current_gap: Waterlines survey models, but deployment qualification and live shadow comparison are not yet a continuous promotion rail.
patterns.desktop_translation: Route a sampled copy of eligible jobs to the candidate, compare receipts privately, and promote only after bounded criteria.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Shadow qualification will detect silent regressions and supply-chain drift before they alter accepted work.
patterns.first_experiment: Shadow a new local quantization across 50 production-like tasks with no write authority.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Contextual bandit routing
patterns.mechanism: Use observed task features and accepted outcomes to choose routes while reserving bounded exploration for uncertainty.
patterns.current_gap: The estate has fixed waterlines and route ladders, but it does not continuously adapt to new models, task drift, and price changes.
patterns.desktop_translation: Learn a policy over task-family, context, runtime, cache state, and acceptance history, constrained by privacy and authority.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Online routing will reduce regret versus static ladders while discovering new model niches.
patterns.first_experiment: Replay historical tasks in chronological order and compare static routing with an off-policy bandit simulation.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Value-of-information teacher acquisition
patterns.mechanism: Spend frontier calls where the expected reduction in future uncertainty or capture cost is highest.
patterns.current_gap: The distillation lab ranks recurring residue, but teacher-query selection remains mostly hand-designed or disagreement-based.
patterns.desktop_translation: Estimate information gain over routing, verifier, and capture hypotheses before each teacher call.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A fixed teacher budget allocated by value of information will produce more replay-clearing capability than random or recurrence-only selection.
patterns.first_experiment: Compare random, disagreement, and information-gain teacher selection on one residue family under equal call budget.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Sequential evidence stopping
patterns.mechanism: Stop experiments when evidence crosses predeclared support, falsification, futility, or safety boundaries.
patterns.current_gap: K floors prevent one-shot claims, but many sweeps still run a fixed matrix after the result is already obvious or hopeless.
patterns.desktop_translation: Add alpha-spending or Bayesian decision thresholds while preserving preregistration and optional maximum sample size.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Sequential stopping will reduce model and hardware spend without increasing false promotion.
patterns.first_experiment: Simulate and then run sequential stopping over known settled and unstable Tier Bench cells.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Pareto governor for quality, attention, cost, and custody
patterns.mechanism: Preserve a frontier of nondominated routes rather than collapsing all objectives into one score.
patterns.current_gap: The estate keeps separate ledgers, but operational choice still needs a principled way to present trade-offs without hiding them.
patterns.desktop_translation: Maintain per-family Pareto sets and let operator policy select among them by context.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A Pareto governor will avoid false precision and expose when cheaper work costs more attention or custody.
patterns.first_experiment: Compute Pareto frontiers from existing waterline and theory fixtures and test policy selections under changed priorities.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Attention-sensitive review broker
patterns.mechanism: Estimate the cost of interruption and defer non-urgent review requests to opportune moments.
patterns.current_gap: Attention is measured after work, but the Desk does not yet decide when and how to summon the operator.
patterns.desktop_translation: Classify review requests by urgency, reversibility, context-loading cost, and deadline; deliver them through batched decision packets.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Attention-aware delivery will reduce context switches and active operator minutes per accepted result.
patterns.first_experiment: Replay one week of hypothetical Desk review events against immediate alerts and bounded review windows.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Batched review windows
patterns.mechanism: Aggregate similar decisions and present them together with shared context and one reattachment cost.
patterns.current_gap: The user can leave work running, but returns may still arrive as a stream of unrelated micro-decisions.
patterns.desktop_translation: Group reviews by project, authority type, evidence shape, and required mental model.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Batched reviews will reduce operator minutes without increasing missed urgent decisions.
patterns.first_experiment: Compare 50 simulated mixed review events under immediate, chronological batch, and semantic batch presentation.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Detachment and reattachment packets
patterns.mechanism: Persist the exact mental state needed to resume work after hours or interruption.
patterns.current_gap: Receipts preserve machine state, but the operator still reconstructs why the work matters, what changed, and what decision remains.
patterns.desktop_translation: Emit end-of-shift and return packets containing goals, completed evidence, open decisions, next safe action, and stale assumptions.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Reattachment packets will shorten first-intervention time and reduce repeated repository archaeology.
patterns.first_experiment: Run a two-week crossover study on selected projects using ordinary dashboards versus generated reattachment packets.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Review debt and aging policy
patterns.mechanism: Track the cost and risk of deferred human decisions and escalate only when delay changes the option set.
patterns.current_gap: Held work is visible, but the estate does not price decision aging, expiring evidence, or blocked descendants.
patterns.desktop_translation: Calculate review debt from blocked value, deadline, reversibility, and context decay.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Aging policy will surface the few delayed decisions that actually threaten throughput while leaving reversible work quiet.
patterns.first_experiment: Apply the policy to historical held branches, inbox requests, and campaign gates; compare with chronological review.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Versioned capability registry
patterns.mechanism: Register each promoted behavior as a versioned artifact with scope, dependencies, tests, provenance, and owner.
patterns.current_gap: Captured artifacts exist, but the estate lacks one authoritative inventory of what capability is currently trusted for which task family.
patterns.desktop_translation: Create capability manifests that point to action digests, models, adapters, verifiers, waterline cells, and replay receipts.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A registry will let routing use capabilities rather than brand names and expose unsupported succession claims.
patterns.first_experiment: Populate manifests for ten existing Tier Bench lenses, composite routes, and local utilities.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Continuous drift and requalification
patterns.mechanism: Re-run bounded qualification when source distribution, runtime, model, dependency, or grader changes.
patterns.current_gap: Waterlines are historically sealed but not automatically scheduled for requalification after relevant drift.
patterns.desktop_translation: Attach invalidation triggers and a lightweight canary corpus to each capability manifest.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Drift-triggered requalification will catch silent regressions before they become recurring failures.
patterns.first_experiment: Change model quantization, runtime version, prompt, and source distribution in fixtures and verify exact requalification scope.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Promotion, demotion, and rollback rail
patterns.mechanism: Treat capability trust as a state machine with evidence-governed promotion and automatic or operator-approved demotion.
patterns.current_gap: Capture closure exists, but operational rollback and route withdrawal are not one unified process.
patterns.desktop_translation: Define candidate, shadow, admitted, preferred, degraded, quarantined, and retired states with exact transition predicates.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A lifecycle rail will reduce time spent diagnosing known-bad routes and make rollback deterministic.
patterns.first_experiment: Simulate a promoted local adapter that later fails canaries; verify routing withdrawal and prior version restoration.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Software-first capability capture
patterns.mechanism: Attempt to compile residue into rules, context selection, tests, tools, and deterministic code before training weights.
patterns.current_gap: The distillation lab permits source artifacts, but no policy forces the cheapest and most inspectable capture class to be tried first.
patterns.desktop_translation: Order capture attempts: deterministic program, verifier, context compiler, prompt scaffold, adapter, LoRA, then larger model.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A substantial fraction of frontier residue will collapse into auditable software rather than new model weights.
patterns.first_experiment: Take five historical frontier repairs and attempt each capture class under equal replay criteria.

patterns.title: End-to-end causal tracing
patterns.mechanism: Propagate one trace identity through context selection, model calls, tools, cache, effects, graders, and operator interventions.
patterns.current_gap: Receipts are rich but distributed across run directories and ledgers, making cross-system latency and failure attribution expensive.
patterns.desktop_translation: Adopt span and parent relationships with sampled fine-grained telemetry and full evidence links for failures.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Causal tracing will reduce diagnosis time and reveal hidden attention, cache, and transport bottlenecks.
patterns.first_experiment: Instrument one complete local-first campaign and reconstruct the critical path automatically.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Routine chaos and fault injection
patterns.mechanism: Inject controlled process death, disk pressure, network loss, stale cache, bad clock, and corrupted outputs before production encounters them.
patterns.current_gap: Theory fixtures include some induced failures, but the operating plane lacks a recurring resilience campaign.
patterns.desktop_translation: Schedule bounded chaos tests against supervisor, workflow replay, cache, and effect reconciliation contracts.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Routine fault injection will convert recovery assumptions into measured capabilities.
patterns.first_experiment: Run a weekly matrix of ten faults against a disposable estate and require receipt-complete recovery.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Attention service-level objectives
patterns.mechanism: Define budgets for operator interruptions, active minutes, decision latency, and blocked-value aging.
patterns.current_gap: Attention is the stated objective but lacks operational SLOs that can govern the scheduler and trigger design work.
patterns.desktop_translation: Set project and estate-level error budgets for attention, analogous to reliability budgets.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: Attention SLOs will make regressions visible and force automation where the operator is still the hidden worker.
patterns.first_experiment: Measure one month of Desk interventions and propose initial SLOs from actual distributions.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.

patterns.title: Reproducible estate rebuild and disaster drill
patterns.mechanism: Regularly reconstruct the operating estate from signed source, manifests, caches-as-optional accelerants, and external backups.
patterns.current_gap: Local replication and custody work exists, but the new execution, distillation, and capability layers need one integrated recovery proof.
patterns.desktop_translation: Automate bare-machine restoration, verify every promoted capability, and report missing secrets or non-reproducible state.
patterns.testable_hypothesis: A successful drill will prove that no resident process, vendor session, or opaque cache is the real estate.
patterns.first_experiment: Restore Tier Bench plus one AXM spoke into a clean VM and run gold qualification without using existing work directories.
patterns.failure_default: Preserve as unimplemented or falsified; do not route production work through the pattern.
